title: Chick holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#FFD93B'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='74' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='38' r='18' fill='#FFE24A'/>
  <!-- head lighter top -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='34' r='13' fill='#FFEE85'/>
  <!-- wing left -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='66' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#FFC107' transform='rotate(15 30 66)'/>
  <!-- wing right (holding heart up) -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='58' rx='7' ry='13' fill='#FFC107' transform='rotate(-35 64 58)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='37' r='3.2' fill='#2B2350'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='37' r='3.2' fill='#2B2350'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='36' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='36' r='1.1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M44 45 L52 45 L48 51 Z' fill='#FF8A3D'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='44' r='3' fill='#FF9E7A'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='44' r='3' fill='#FF9E7A'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M38 86 L38 90 M44 87 L44 91' stroke='#FF8A3D' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 87 L52 91 M58 86 L58 90' stroke='#FF8A3D' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- heart held above right wing -->
  <path d='M64 40 C64 34 72 33 73 39 C74 33 82 34 82 40 C82 47 73 53 73 53 C73 53 64 47 64 40 Z' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <path d='M67 40 C67 37 71 36 71.5 39' stroke='#FF90A8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
